name: Outcast
description: Convicted of crimes. Only the plainest food, and no place in the Academy or the Market.

name: Freeman
description: Known for good work. Better meals, a seat at the Academy and market days.

name: Artisan
description: A master of a craft or a proven fighter. Fine meals, and first pick of new homes after the notables.

name: Notable
description: A pillar of the community. The best meals and first claim on a home.

name: Noble
description: Renowned throughout the land. Their children are born with a head start.
